changelog: Phase H (P25-P28): Polish, Documentation & Versioning. Wired 'View Report Card' on student profile to pre-fill and launch ReportCardModal directly for the latest exam term with class selector locked. Added student reactivation workflow for 'Left' status records preserving attendance and fee history. Fixed promotion rollback snapshot reactive computation and version keying in StudentManagementPage. Added 30s synchronizer tick interval in Header SyncStatus to prevent frozen relative timestamps. Implemented automatic attendance UI rollback to current state when save operations fail. Rewrote README.md and UserManual.md to accurately document single-school architecture, campus branches, in-app backup, and mobile PWA capabilities.
